title: RBAC v2: Enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging for private deployments
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Enforcement: RBAC v2 now validates KMS key region pinning for private deployments; Audit: Audit logs emit KMS key binding events and region resolution decisions; Migration: Adds config-check and dry-run migration mode to validate existing clusters.
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private and on-prem deployments require stronger guarantees that customer-managed KMS keys and secrets are resolved and used in the correct cloud region to meet data residency and compliance requirements. This PR extends RBAC v2 policy enforcement to validate KMS key region pinning at mutation time and emits structured audit events when keys are bound or when fallback to regional defaults occurs. Changes: 1) policy_enforcer: add KMSRegionPin rule that rejects role/grant changes if the specified KMS key region does not match the cluster's allowed regions; 2) kms/region_resolver: centralized resolver that normalizes key ARNs, resolves region metadata, and returns canonical region tags used by policies; 3) audit: add audit events for kms.key_bound and kms.region_resolution including resolution_reason and matched_policy; 4) installer: add preflight checks that detect mismatched cluster-region configurations and a dry-run migration tool to report actionable fixes; 5) tests: unit and integration tests for enforcement and audit emission; 6) docs: migration guide and console UI hint for admin. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag "rbac_v2_kms_pin", deploy to staging with dry-run enabled for 48 hours, enable enforcement for a small set of pilot customers, then flip enforcement cluster-by-cluster. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves previous permissive resolution unless the feature flag is enabled. Migration: provided dry-run mode for cluster admins to list impacted policies and suggested fixes. Related: ENG-4821, SEC-214, SUP-8301.
commits_summary: 7 commits: add resolver and enforcer; wire audit events; installer preflight and migration tool; docs and tests. Commits include initial implementation, follow-up to fix race in cache, test additions, and CI lint fixes.
diff_snippets: +++ services/rbac/v2/policy_enforcer.go: add KMSRegionPin rule check that calls kms.ResolveRegion(keyARN) and compares to cluster.AllowedRegions
+++ services/kms/region_resolver.go: new ResolveRegion func that returns {region, resolution_reason} and caches ARN->region mapping with TTL
+++ services/audit/audit_emitter.go: emit event kms.key_bound with fields: user_id, key_arn, resolved_region, policy_id, resolution_reason
review_conversation: Sofia: requested stronger unit tests around resolver cache eviction and a note about IAM throttling. Diego: asked to keep the default behavior permissive behind a feature flag and suggested dry-run first. Ethan: approved after small refactor to split resolution and validation logic. Author: implemented cache eviction test, added retry/backoff on IAM DescribeKey calls, added feature flag and dry-run path, updated docs. CI flake: fixed by increasing test timeout for integration test that polls audit stream.
ci_checks: go-build: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass after rerun (increasing timeout); lint: pass; e2e-private-installer: pass on staging; security-scan: pass with minor findings addressed (hardcoded region strings removed).
notes_for_ops: Feature gated by rbac_v2_kms_pin. To enable enforcement: flip feature flag via admin console or CLI per-cluster after running migration dry-run and resolving reported policies. Monitor metrics: kms_region_resolution_failures, audit.kms.key_bound, rbac.enforcement.denials. Rollback: flip feature flag off to restore permissive behavior.
changelog_entry: RBAC v2: Enforce KMS region pinning and emit audit events for key-region binding. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for migration steps.
